title: --playtest-log override accepted unsanitized; no user:// confinement or traversal filter
detail: Override value is returned verbatim and reaches make_dir_recursive_absolute + truncate WRITE with no user:// confinement or '..' filter. Safe today only because the source is OS.get_cmdline_user_args() (trusted launcher); no untrusted boundary is crossed.
recommended_fix: If the arg source ever becomes less-trusted (config file, remote), confine to user:// and reject '..'/absolute paths. Meanwhile, state the launcher-trust assumption in the override docstring so future wiring doesn't silently widen exposure.
